headlines.title: 구윤철 " 외환시장 예의주시...과도한 쏠림엔 즉시 조치 "
headlines.summary: 미국 관세와 이란 전쟁 영향에 외환시장 변동성이 커진 가운데 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관은 지나친 쏠림에는 필요한 조치를 즉시 취할 것이라고 밝혔습니다. 구 부총리는 오늘 오전 정부서울청사에서 주재한 시장상황점검회의에서 대외 불확실성이 높은 상황에서 불안 심리가 확산하지 않도록 높은 경계감을 가지고 예의주시하고 있다며 이같이 언급했습니다.

headlines.title: 구윤철 " 과도한 쏠림 즉시 대응 "… 환율 변동성 확대 경계
headlines.summary: 중동 전쟁·외국인 순매도에 외환시장 변동성 확대 정부, 금융·외환시장 리스크 점검 강화 채권시장 변동성에도 관계기관 공조 대응 [서울=뉴시스] 고범준 기자 = 이재명 대통령이 2일 청와대에서 열린 제24회 국무회의 겸 제11차 비상경제점검회의에서 구윤철 경제부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관과 대화하고 있다. 2026.06.02. bjko@newsis.

headlines.title: 환율 두달 만에 다시 1530원대로
headlines.summary: 장중 1530.8원, 3월 31일 이후 최고치 외환보유액도 5월 8억8000만弗 감소 이란의 미군기지 공격에 유가 등 상승 구윤철 “과도 쏠림 즉시 조치 취할 것” 원/달러 환율이 약 두 달 만에 1530원을 다시 돌파했다. 시작가 기준으로는 글로벌 금융위기 이후 처음이다. 서울 중구 명동 일대 환전소 모습.

headlines.title: OECD 한국 성장 률 2.6% 전망, G20중 전망 상향폭 최대
headlines.summary: 세계경제 성장률 전망치, 3월(2.9%) 대비 하향된 2.8% 제시 한국경제 성장률은 같은 기간 1.7%→2.6%, G20국가 중 상향폭 최대 (부산=뉴스1) 윤일지 기자 = 지난 3월 우리나라 수출이 반도체 '슈퍼 사이클'(초호황)에 힘입어 사상 처음으로 800억 달러를 돌파하며 역대 최대 실적을 기록했다.

headlines.title: 닭고기 수급난 … 굽네치킨, 가격 인상 대신 중량 줄였다
headlines.summary: 닭다리살 순살·윙봉·통다리 중량 축소 ‘치킨 중량 표시제’ 시행 6개월만 첫사례 “판매가·공급가 인상 어렵자 고육지책” [굽네치킨 홈페이지] 고병원성 AI(조류인플루엔자) 여파로 닭고기 수급난을 겪는 프랜차이즈 치킨업계에서 중량 조정 사례가 나왔다. 정부가 슈링크플레이션 방지를 위해 ‘치킨 중량 표시제’를 시행한 지 약 6개월 만이다.

key_headlines.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Breaks Through 1,530 for First Time Since March Amid US Tariffs and Middle East Tensions
key_headlines.summary: The won-dollar exchange rate surged to 1,530 won on June 4th, driven by strong dollar momentum from US-Iran military tensions and US tariff pressures. This marks the first breach of the 1,530 level since the 2009 global financial crisis.

key_headlines.title: Korea's 2026 Export Target Reaches 900 Billion Dollars, Approaching One Trillion Dollar Dream and Targeting 5th Largest Exporter Status
key_headlines.summary: South Korea aims to achieve 900 billion dollars in exports this year, building on last year's record 700 billion dollars, with potential to surpass Japan and become the world's 5th largest exporter. AI-era semiconductor and power equipment exports are driving this growth.

key_headlines.title: Capital Region Ready-Mix Concrete Workers' General Strike Halts Semiconductor Construction Sites from June 8th
key_headlines.summary: Ready-mix concrete mixer truck operators in the capital region plan a complete halt of operations starting June 8th, threatening major semiconductor construction projects in Pyeongtek and Yongin. The strike poses significant risks to ongoing infrastructure and manufacturing projects.

key_headlines.title: Foreign Investors Execute Record Second-Largest Net Selling of 7 Trillion Won, Pushing Exchange Rate Above 1,540 Won
key_headlines.summary: Foreign investors conducted massive net selling worth 7 trillion won of domestic stocks amid Middle East tensions and US interest rate hike expectations, driving the won-dollar exchange rate past 1,540 won. This represents the 19th consecutive day of foreign net selling.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Mayor-elect Oh Se-hoon Warns of Real Estate Crisis as Jeonse (Long-Term Lease) Plummets and Monthly Rent Surges
key_headlines.summary: Incoming Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon identifies rapidly declining jeonse (long-term lease) deposits and soaring monthly rents as Seoul's most critical issue, warning of potential real estate catastrophe without policy direction changes. He pledges to accelerate private-sector redevelopment and reconstruction projects to supply 310,000 new housing units by 2031.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy faces mounting pressures from multiple headwinds including the won-dollar exchange rate surging to 1,530 won for the first time since 2009, driven by Middle East tensions and US tariff concerns. Foreign investors are executing massive sell-offs of Korean stocks, with 7 trillion won in net selling recorded amid concerns about US interest rate hikes. The capital region ready-mix concrete strike threatens to halt semiconductor construction projects starting June 8th. Despite these challenges, Korea's export sector remains robust with targets of 900 billion dollars for 2026, potentially reaching the long-sought 1 trillion dollar milestone.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government projects inflation at 2.7% for 2026 while the OECD has downgraded global economic growth to 2.8% due to Middle East crisis impacts, warning of potential 1% growth if energy crises persist. The Korean government faces the triple challenge of high exchange rates, high inflation, and high interest rates, which risks deepening wealth inequality and widening the gap between rich and poor. The Bank of Korea maintained its base rate at current levels but signaled hawkish tones regarding future rate increases, while the government considers deregulating the oil price ceiling system depending on July crude prices. Semiconductor supercycles and expansionary fiscal policies are expected to support growth in the mid-to-late 2% range.
sections.Financial Markets: KOSPI declined 1.84% to 8,639.41 points as foreign investors conducted their 19th consecutive day of net selling worth 6.9 trillion won, while individual investors purchased 5 trillion won. KOSDAQ outperformed with a 2% gain as small and mid-size companies attracted investor interest following KOSPI weakness. Samsung Electronics fell 2.5% and SK Hynix dropped 2.63% following disappointing AI chip results from Broadcom, impacting semiconductor stocks across Asia. Samsung Fire and Marine Insurance surged 13% on interest rate hike expectations and foreign buying interest, while the won-dollar exchange rate breached 1,540 won amid capital outflows.
sections.Industry & Technology: The semiconductor, automotive, battery, shipbuilding, and steel industries face growing labor union risks that could impact global competitiveness, with concerns about strikes similar to recent labor disputes affecting production continuity. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang visited Korean startups for the second time in a week, signaling increased strategic focus on Korean technology companies, particularly in emerging manufacturing sectors like autonomous vehicles, shipbuilding, and batteries. Samsung Electro-Mechanics and LG Innotech are accelerating investments in Vietnamese semiconductor substrate facilities to capitalize on global AI chip demand expansion. The biotech industry faces potential labor disputes with implications comparable to semiconductor strikes, particularly regarding continuous process protection during work stoppages.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's real estate market faces a critical juncture with jeonse (long-term lease) deposits plummeting while monthly rents surge, prompting incoming Mayor Oh Se-hoon to prioritize housing supply expansion as Seoul's top policy issue. Supply-capped apartments with price ceiling regulations are experiencing 2.5 times higher subscription competition rates compared to regular projects as consumers seek more affordable housing options. Oh Se-hoon's administration plans to accelerate private-sector redevelopment and reconstruction projects, targeting 310,000 new housing completions by 2031, particularly in central Seoul where development is concentrated. Seoul apartment jeonse value increases are now outpacing sales price growth as demand shifts toward long-term leasing due to cautious purchase sentiment, creating severe shortage situations in the rental market.
sections.International Economy: The Federal Reserve shows signs of potential rate increases with hawk-leaning officials suggesting possibility of rate hikes, while market expectations for December FOMC rate increases have surged from 9.1% one month ago to 41.1% currently. US stock indices fell across the board due to Middle East tensions, surging oil prices, and renewed tariff announcements, with the NASDAQ declining 0.89%. The won weakened significantly against other Asian currencies including the yen, driven by strong dollar momentum and capital outflows amid global uncertainty. Fed Chair Powell may overhaul the Fed's communication system starting with the current FOMC meeting, potentially affecting policy guidance and market expectations.
sections.AI & Economy: The European Union is implementing energy conservation policies targeting households to manage peak evening power demand surging due to AI data centers and electric vehicle expansion, reflecting strain on power infrastructure from AI adoption. Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon maintains optimistic views on AI and the US economy long-term, predicting higher productivity and lower unemployment within 10 years, though cautioning that market sentiment could shift rapidly from greed to fear. Focus AI completed an 8 billion won capital increase to strengthen financial stability and accelerate physical security and industrial safety AI solutions. SK-invested TerraPower's advanced SMR (Small Modular Reactor) project in the US has achieved rapid progress, with a 35-meter facility constructed in just three months, supporting Trump administration's nuclear energy renaissance initiative.
sections.Others: Seven regions in Gyeongnam, Gyeongbuk, and Jeolla provinces will be designated as new regulatory free zones focusing on energy and biotech industries to promote local industrial development. Hanwha Aerospace halted domestic production lines due to safety concerns despite strong export-driven performance, with criticism over insufficient investment in safety relative to revenue growth. Global PE firm EQT acquired Korean companies More (business card management) and Doozen (ERP solutions) as AI-driven industry consolidation winners. The Trump administration's nuclear renaissance initiative is advancing with TerraPower's SMR project progressing rapidly in desert locations. Geopolitical tensions may ease with Trump reportedly signaling internally that the US will not resume full-scale conflict with Iran unless American military personnel are harmed.
